probe.text_sample: Otherkind Otherkind is a craft-led design studio that specializes in 0→1 brand and product design. You pull us in when you need to build tempo and momentum. Led by vbahk and dpark, our team embeds within your founding team to create inspiration, find clarity in ambiguity, and walk alongside you as you build your vision. Get in touch: hello@otherkind.design Past Engagements Cloudflare 2026 UDIO 2026 Cerebral Valley 2026 USVC 2026 Lore 2026 Doji 2025 Pika 2025 Ditto 2025 Shibuya (bop) 2025 Humanmost 2025 Yutori 2024 Alta 2024 [untitled] 2024 Crypto the Game S1 2024 Select Projects Team We exist to create a sanctuary for creativity. We want to inspire ourselves and everyone who collaborates with us. Aside from that, we also exist to have fun. Everyone internally and externally should enjoy the process of design. If this resonates with you, we're currently hiring for product, web, and visual designers. Email jobs@otherkind.design with your portfolio.
